insights: Kids clothing shops in Nasr City converted best (3 of 4 won, 75% vs 60% overall) — score them higher.
Leads with 50+ Google reviews won 4 of 5 times; leads with fewer than 10 reviews won 0 of 3 — favour established shops.
Score band 7–8 won 4 of 5 (80%) while 4–6 won 1 of 4 (25%) — keep the threshold at 7 for first touches.
Shops with a website won 3 of 4; it is a positive signal, but a missing website is not a reason to disqualify.
icp_suggestions: Add Nasr City and Heliopolis as priority cities in Cairo.
Add 'fewer than 10 reviews' as a nice-to-have negative signal rather than a disqualifier.
caveats: Only 10 outcomes so far (6 won, 4 lost); treat these as early signals and re-run after more deals close.
